duplicate_policy: Remove exact duplicates across all eight source columns; these may include indistinguishable real lines, so all removed rows are retained for audit. Do not deduplicate by invoice/product alone.
customer_policy: Keep missing identifiers as Unknown. Do not impute an identity or discard their invoice value.
value_scope: Signed invoice-line amount, positive prices only; includes service and mixed product codes. Not audited GAAP revenue, profit, or matched-return cohort rate.
